timeline.text: One child's deck on the family kiosk had just twelve cards to his brothers' thirty.
It also just looped the same cards, with no ladder and no due dates.
Now spaced repetition puts every card on a schedule, and short decks got topped up to match.
Reading gaps with no question before now pull fresh ones from his own stored work.
He now keeps pace with his brothers all evening - throughput on the wall is up forty percent.
